scope: Standing upstream synchronization policy for the Qwen MXFP4 MLX campaign

mlx.private_change_policy: Keep MLX source close to upstream; keep campaign implementations in mlx-lm; keep local MLX additions primarily under docs, evidence, and benchmarks
tests: PYTHONPATH=$PWD/python python -m pytest python/tests/test_conv.py python/tests/test_fast_sdpa.py python/tests/test_reduce.py -q

mlx-lm.private_change_policy: Merge upstream into private main; keep the Qwen runtime in dedicated modules and minimize edits in shared loader/server files
tests: PYTHONPATH=$PWD python -m pytest tests/test_qwen4_exp_ple.py tests/test_dynamic_quant.py tests/test_greedy_fast.py tests/test_ple_runtime.py tests/test_server.py -q
expected_conflicts: mlx_lm/server.py: union upstream processor import with private greedy_sampler import and retain idle warmup hooks
mlx_lm/utils.py: union MODEL_REMAPPING additions and retain private post-load fuse/compile hooks

numerical_exclusions.title: Keep split-K quantized matmul partials in float32
numerical_exclusions.state: upstream commit present; local revert active
numerical_exclusions.reason: changed the fixed 4096-token Qwen continuation at a near tie

acceptance_gates.source_tests: Run repository-specific focused suites before model gates
acceptance_gates.mlx_change: Build both cores and compare old versus new with at least five alternating short-context pairs and three 4096-token pairs
acceptance_gates.mlx_lm_change: Run focused private suites and a real-model smoke; use same-process A/B when only Python runtime changes
acceptance_gates.promotion: Merge first in an integration worktree; merge private main only after tests and Qwen gates pass

git_policy.merge_style: merge upstream/main; do not rebase private main
git_policy.resmp_dev_push: publishes our work when the user authorizes it

upstream_contribution_policy.reason: Maintainers do not want our contributions and have not asked for them.
upstream_contribution_policy.reverse_requires: explicit user reversal of this policy

non_claims: No distributed two-rank gate is part of this policy yet.
No upstream PR, issue, comment, or patch is prepared or opened by policy.
